caption:
How much torque does a first wheel need? The Logitech G29 has about 2.2 Nm through gears, the T248R 3.1 Nm, the T598 and GT DD Pro 5 Nm of direct drive, where heavy cars can still feel light. The Moza R9 V3 has 9 Nm for about $329, still fine on a desk, but it doesn't work on PlayStation. Prices are our estimates. We earn from qualifying purchases. #simracing #racingwheel

title: How many Nm does a first racing wheel need? 2.2 to 9 Nm, in plain numbers
